sloka: कथम् नाम महाभागा सीता जनकनन्दिनी ।सदा सुखेष्वभिरता दुःखान्यनुभविष्यति ॥२-४९-७॥
transliteration: katham nāma mahābhāgā sītā janakanandinī ।sadā sukheṣvabhiratā duḥkhānyanubhaviṣyati ॥2-49-7॥

translations.english: How will Sita, highly fortunate daughter of Janaka and used to comforts endure these sufferings?
